title: Clock extraction after partial scan
statement: Let $b_s,\alpha,x$ be Boolean words. For every integer $j$ with $j\le |b_s|$, after $4j$ steps of the prefix parser on $\langle\langle b_s,\alpha\rangle,x\rangle$, its state is the first clock-reading phase, its input head is at position $4j+1$, its work tape stores the prefix of $b_s$ of length $j$, and its output is empty.
replaced:
For every $j \le |b|$, running the prefix parser $4j$ steps from its initial
configuration on the nested pair encoding
$\langle \langle b, \alpha\rangle, x\rangle$ stores exactly the first $j$
clock bits on its work tape, leaves the output empty, and places the input
head just past the $4j$ consumed cells, still in the first clock phase.
